up: Show the exact activity values (standard_value and standard_units) for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1613910. For each compound, include its canonical SMILES and ChEMBL ID. Return all matching rows.
sql:
SELECT
  activities.standard_value,
  activities.standard_units,
  molecule_dictionary.chembl_id,
  compound_structures.canonical_smiles
FROM activities
JOIN molecule_dictionary
  ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
JOIN compound_structures
  ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
WHERE activities.assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613910')
  AND activities.standard_relation = '=';
